newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cenbank to sell 196-day bonds Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cenbank to sell 196-day bonds Tuesday.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank will offer 189-day and 196-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) for the first time at its weekly auction Tuesday, the bank said in a statement.
The Central Bank will also sell Tuesday 182-day BBCs as it has been doing in the last few months.
The new bonds are seen as part of the government's current policy to stretch the maturity period of Brazil's public debt, dealers said.
At Tuesday's auction, the Central Bank will offer 3.0 billion reais face value in 182-day BBCs, 2.5 billion reais face value in 189-day BBCs, and 2.5 billion reais face value in 196-day BBCs.
On Wednesday, 8.0 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due, dealers said.
